images.title: Bricks in a unit square
images.purpose: Show a brick of side 1/5 has area 1/25, so 25 bricks fill 1 square unit.
images.composition: One large unit square centred, side labels, one caption, white space.
exact_structure: One unit square split into 5 equal rows and 5 equal columns: 25 equal brick cells.
Exactly 1 cell (top left) filled amber #E69F00; the other 24 white; grid grey #6B7280.
Side label 1/5 along the top of the amber cell and 1/5 along its left side, in teal #0072B2.
Below the square, two short caption lines: '1 brick = 1/25' in reddish purple #CC79A7 and '25 bricks make 1 square unit' in grey #6B7280.
images.takeaway: A brick of side 1/5 has area 1/25, so a square unit holds 25 bricks.
images.description: A unit square cut into 25 small squares with one brick highlighted and labelled 1/25.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video.
images.teaching_notes: Count 25 bricks in the square unit, then scale up to the larger area.

image_decisions.why: The picture shows brick area before dividing the total area.
